# iosxe_voice_port (Resource)

This resource can manage the Voice Port configuration.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "iosxe_voice_port" "example" {
  port        = "0/1/0:23"
  description = "PSTN PRI trunk"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `port` (String)

### Optional

- `delete_mode` (String) Configure behavior when deleting/destroying the resource. Either delete the entire object (YANG container) being managed, or only delete the individual resource attributes configured explicitly and leave everything else as-is. Default value is `all`.
  - Choices: `all`, `attributes`
- `description` (String) Description of what this port is connected to
- `device` (String) A device name from the provider configuration.
- `shutdown` (Boolean) Take voice-port offline
- `translation_profile_incoming` (String) Translation Profile for incoming call leg
- `translation_profile_outgoing` (String) Translation Profile for outgoing call leg
- `vad` (Boolean) Voice Activity Detection

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The path of the object.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import iosxe_voice_port.example "<port>"
```
